mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.incident.get_details
mcpTools.description: Return the fields of one incident. Fulfillers get the full record including assignment, CI and work notes; a requester gets a reduced field set and comments only, and only for incidents they own (otherwise NOT_FOUND).
mcpTools.notes: Input parameter names are ResolvrNow choices; behaviour documented.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.incident.modify
mcpTools.description: Update an incident. Fulfillers may set any writable field, work notes, comments, assignee and assignment group; business rules run. A requester may only, on an owned incident: add a comment, escalate (escalate + escalation_reason, alone), or resolve an active incident; other fields return FORBIDDEN.

assigned_to.description: User name, user id or sys_id

mcpTools.notes: Escalation refused when state is Resolved, Closed or Canceled, urgency already High, or escalated within 24 hours (Documented).

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.incident.search_similar
mcpTools.description: Semantic search for incidents similar to a given incident or a free-text description; ranked results with scores.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.lookup_assignment_groups
mcpTools.description: Find assignment groups by name or keyword, optionally with their members.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.lookup_users
mcpTools.description: Find users by name, role or group membership.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.incident.search_similar_kb
mcpTools.description: Search active, published knowledge articles from a query or from an incident (its short description and details). Each hit has article number, relevance score, knowledge base, title and URL.
mcpTools.notes: The documentation prints this name with a stray space after the prefix.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.incident.get_kb_details
mcpTools.description: Return one published knowledge article (title, knowledge base, state, publish date, full body) by number or sys_id.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.incident.attach_kb
mcpTools.description: Link an active, published knowledge article to an incident as a reference. Returns {status: "attached", incident, kb_number, message}.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.change.lifecycle
mcpTools.description: Change request lifecycle. operation=create (from model, template or type), update (fields, state transition, journal), calculate_risk (risk calculator, including the questionnaire), upsert_task (create or update a change task), planned_outage (create a planned outage for the change).

state.description: Target state name for a transition

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.change.analyze
mcpTools.description: Change analysis. operation=suggest_assignment_groups, get_risk_and_impact_data (risk score and blast radius), suggest_cis (ranked by confidence), suggest_models_and_templates.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.change.query
mcpTools.description: Change queries. operation=read (by numbers, with summaries), search (paged; encoded query, filters or text), similar_change_and_issues (needs incident read), aggregate_by (cross-tab or independent counts), get_state_info (state, valid next states, mandatory fields), check_schedules_and_conflicts (with freshness), data_quality (score and guidance).

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.change.relation
mcpTools.description: Change relations. operation=list_tasks, list_affected_cis (and impacted services), list_approvals (scope mine or all), list_incidents (fixed by, caused by, on affected CIs), list_problems, list_outages, list_change_policies (grouped, first and last applied).

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.requester.create_incident
mcpTools.description: Guided creation for the authenticated requester: knowledge deflection, catalog redirection, duplicate detection among the requester's open incidents, field review, then creation. Call repeatedly with session_id; returns the next step, or an incident number with portal link, or a requested item number.
mcpTools.notes: Backed by the Create Incident agent (Documented); step protocol is ResolvrNow.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.requester.check_status
mcpTools.description: Status of the authenticated user's own incident or requested item, by number or natural reference ('my VPN ticket', 'my latest request'). Incident: number, short description, description, priority, urgency, impact, state, created by, created on. RITM: number, approval, state, stage, estimated delivery, whether the caller is the requested-for user.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.request.modify
mcpTools.description: Add a customer-visible comment to the authenticated user's own requested item. Incident numbers and closed or cancelled items are rejected.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.oncall.on_call_lookup
mcpTools.description: operation=who_is_on_call (members and contacts for a group or shift at a time) or my_next_shift (caller's next or active shift: group, shift, times, responder level; one entry per roster).
mcpTools.notes: On-call tools are inactive by default (Documented).

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.oncall.timeoff_request
mcpTools.description: Two phases. analyze: read-only check of affected groups, PTO policy, coverage needs, eligible covers, conflicting requests. create: submit with the coverage plan the user confirmed; never without explicit confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Returned by analyze; required by create

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.itsm_knowledge_graph
mcpTools.description: Answer a structured natural-language question about ITSM data: incidents and changes not Closed Complete, active request and catalog items.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.get_session_timezone
mcpTools.description: Return the caller's session time zone and the current local date-time. Call before interpreting dates or relative date phrases.

mcpTools.name: sn_itsm_mcp_server.task_approval_decision
mcpTools.description: Record an approve or reject decision on the oldest approval that is waiting for the caller, for a change request or a requested item.
